blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Users are asking language models mental health questions and are receiving answers. We audited what 41 language models recommend to users when the same clinical information reaches them from three footings: a clinician describing a patient, a caregiver describing a loved one, or a person describing themselves. Across 19 case vignettes and five questions, we collected 35,055 free-text responses, extracted every intervention named with a validated judge, and had 29 models rate the full option lists on a seven-point Likert scale for the same cases. Models largely recommend what they rate well, with recommendation behavior differing by footing, and many models offering clinicians a consultation-style response and lay users hedged, simplified advice. When asked about recommendations for a specific intervention type, models more often named options they themselves rated below zero as initial choices, usually with conditions attached. We will release the instrument, code, and full corpus on publication as a living audit.
blocks.zh: 用户正在询问语言模型心理健康问题,并得到了答案。 我们审核了41种语言模型向用户推荐的内容, 当同样的临床信息从三个方面传到他们:一个临床医生描述病人,一个护理者描述被爱的人,或者一个自我描述的人。 在19个案件和5个问题中,我们收集了35,055份自由文本答复,提取了每个由经认证的法官命名的干预,并且有29个模型在相同案件的7分Irikrt比例上对完整选项清单进行评分。 模型主要建议如何评分,建议行为因基础不同而不同,许多模型为临床医生提供一种咨询式的响应,以及非专业用户进行套期,简化的建议. 当被问及关于特定干预类型的建议时,模型更经常地命名出它们自己被评为零以下的选项作为初始选择,通常附带条件. 我们将公布有关出版的仪器、密码和全书作为活的审计。

blocks.en: \headfont 1  Introduction
blocks.zh: 标题font 导言

blocks.en: It is incumbent upon mental health artificial intelligence (AI) evaluation papers, like most mental health papers, to open with a description of prevalence and impact—to situate the reader within an understanding of a persistent mental health crisis [ 1 , 2 ] , and widespread AI usage for mental health support [ 3 , 4 ] . But, as a recent review found [ 5 ] , such prevalence estimates are generally broad and often underdefined. “Using AI for mental health” covers a wide array of human-computer interactions ranging from crisis de-escalation, to psychoeducation, to companionship, to resource identification, to general emotional support [ 5 ] . Most survey definitions count all of these as mental health use, often overlooking how the same request may be shaped by different interactional footings [ 6 ] : a clinician treating a patient, a caregiver supporting a loved one, or a person seeking help for themselves. This prevalence survey literature has been cited widely to underpin an evaluation landscape highly focused on the specific interactions involving acute crisis and clinical task performance [ 7 ] . Suicide detection [ 8 ] , diagnostic accuracy [ 9 , 10 ] , structured treatment guideline adherence [ 11 , 12 ] , and performance on professional licensing examinations [ 13 ] dominate the current environment in which the mental health performance of large language models (LLMs) is assessed.
blocks.zh: 心理健康人工智能的评价文件,如大多数心理健康文件一样,有责任以描述流行程度和影响的方式开放,使读者了解持续存在的心理健康危机[1、2],并广泛使用AI提供心理健康支助[3、4]。 但是,正如最近的一项审查发现[5],这种流行率估计一般是宽泛的,而且往往定义不足。 “利用AI促进精神健康”涵盖从危机缓和、心理教育、陪伴、资源鉴定到一般情感支持等一系列广泛的人与计算机互动。 大多数调查定义将所有这些都算作心理健康使用,往往忽略了不同互动基础如何塑造同一请求[6]: 治疗病人的临床医生、支助亲人的护理人员或为自己寻求帮助的人。 这一流行性调查文献被广泛引用,作为评价环境的基础,高度侧重于涉及急性危机和临床任务表现的具体互动[7]。 自杀检测[8],诊断精度[9,10],结构化治疗准则的遵守[11,12],专业许可考试的表现[13] 主导着目前评估大语言模型(LLMs)心理健康表现的环境.

blocks.en: This arrangement follows naturally from the transfer of evaluation methods from domains with clear answer keys, like mathematics and software engineering, to mental health. But it produces a brittle evaluation picture, capturing primarily those aspects of mental health-relevant human-computer interactions that can be reduced to correct or incorrect answers [ 14 ] , while overlooking how the appropriateness of a response may depend on the roles and interactional context of the exchange [ 15 ] . Mental health evaluation poses particular challenges, even by the standards of the social sciences, as experts with different training backgrounds (and even within the same backgrounds) often disagree on the appropriateness of responses to the same user presentation [ 16 , 17 , 18 ] . In the absence of expert agreement, many domains (like psychopharmacology and emergency triage) go without AI evaluation infrastructure as both computer scientists and clinicians wait for a consensus that may or may not arrive.
blocks.zh: 这种安排自然产生于评价方法从有明确答案键的领域,如数学和软件工程,转移到心理健康。 但是,它产生了一个简洁的评价画面,主要捕捉到与心理健康相关的人与计算机相互作用的方面,这些方面可以被降低为正确或不正确的答案[14],而忽略了反应的适当性如何可能取决于交换的作用和互动背景[15]. 心理健康评价提出了特殊的挑战,即使社会科学的标准如此,因为具有不同培训背景(甚至同一背景)的专家在对同一用户的介绍作出反应的适当性方面往往存在分歧[16、17、18]。 在没有专家同意的情况下,许多领域(如精神药品学和紧急分解)没有AI评价基础设施,因为计算机科学家和临床医生都等待着可能或可能不会达成的共识.

blocks.en: During this waiting period, language models are still providing direct mental health advice to users, often in convincing tones and despite the disagreements present in the training data. Prior research has investigated how accurate these LLM recommendations are and how equitable they are across different users [ 19 , 20 ] . To measure accuracy, most previous research evaluates whether the output matches an expert standard [ 7 , 14 ] . One team, for example, evaluated four LLMs’ responses to a variety of mental health vignettes and measured treatment recommendations, diagnoses, and prognostic predictions against mental health professional norms [ 19 ] . Other studies have explored similar questions in more specific areas such as bipolar depression and psychoeducation tasks [ 21 , 22 ] . Although these studies provide evidence about clinical concordance, they generally begin with a predefined account of what constitutes an appropriate response, supplied by expert panels that do not necessarily represent the disagreement present across the field [ 16 ] . Without reusable evaluation infrastructure for continuous auditing, there is limited visibility into what mental health interventions the models are recommending and discouraging to users, let alone what they should be recommending.
blocks.zh: 在这一等待期间,尽管培训数据存在分歧,语言模型仍然在向使用者提供直接的心理健康咨询,往往在说服力方面。 先前的研究调查了这些LLM建议是否准确,以及这些建议在不同用户之间是否公平。 为了衡量准确性,以前大多数研究都评价产出是否符合专家标准[7,14]. 例如,一个小组评价了四个LLMs对各种精神健康问题的响应,并根据精神健康专业规范衡量治疗建议、诊断和预测[19]。 其他研究在两极抑郁症和心理教育任务[21,22]等更具体领域探讨了类似的问题. 虽然这些研究提供了临床协调的证据,但一般都从预先界定的构成适当反应的叙述开始,这些说明是由不一定代表整个领域的分歧的专家小组提供的。 没有可用于持续审计的评价基础设施,模型建议和劝阻用户的心理健康干预措施的可见度有限,更不用说他们应该建议什么了。

blocks.en: Beyond evaluating the clinical accuracy of LLM recommendations, prior research has examined whether these recommendations vary across patient characteristics, including demographic and socioeconomic factors [ 23 , 24 , 20 ] . This prior work has found differences in how frequently models direct patients toward urgent care, and how often they suggest invasive interventions and mental health services based on demographics and socioeconomic status presented in the vignettes [ 20 ] . Speaker-side variation expressed via tone, syntax, and demographic markers has been shown to shift treatment recommendations [ 25 , 26 , 27 ] . Recent work has also audited the cost of model-recommended care, which ran about three times that of treating physicians [ 28 ] , and shown that a model’s depression treatment recommendations can shift silently, without changing its weights or prompt [ 29 ] . One important area that remains underexplored is how interactional footing, particularly the user’s relationship to the patient, influences the mental health interventions that language models recommend or discourage.
blocks.zh: 除了评价LLM建议的临床准确性外,以前的研究还研究了这些建议是否因病人特点而异,包括人口和社会经济因素[23、24、20]。 先前的工作发现,模型如何频繁地引导病人接受紧急护理,以及它们根据人口统计和社会经济地位建议入侵性干预和精神保健服务的情况各不相同。 通过语气、语法和人口标志表达的演讲方差异已经证明可以改变治疗建议[25、26、27]。 最近的工作还审计了模型推荐的护理费用,该费用是医生治疗费用([28])的三倍左右,并表明模型抑郁症治疗建议可以默默转移,而不改变其重量或迅速[29]. 尚未充分探讨的一个重要领域是互动基础,特别是使用者与病人的关系如何影响语言模型建议或劝阻的心理健康干预措施。

blocks.en: To our knowledge, this is the first large-scale audit of the mental health interventions LLMs recommend when the same vignette is written from the perspective of a clinician, a caregiver, or the person themselves, both when constrained to one type of intervention and when left unconstrained. We examine both open-ended generation and structured rating to identify current LLM behavior when interacting with humans seeking treatment advice for mental health concerns. We make three contributions in this paper. Empirically, we describe what 41 language models recommend across 19 clinician-reviewed case vignettes and three footings. We do so both in open-ended generation (35,055 responses) and structured rating of four full option lists reported per condition and intervention type. Methodologically, we introduce a paired generation and rating audit design and infrastructure with broader AI recommendation research in mind. Our methods can be adapted to different case vignettes, recommendation sets, and application domains. To support transparency, reproducibility, and future research, we will release the code, vignettes, rating lists, coding guidelines, and full corpus, enabling others to independently audit and extend our findings.
blocks.zh: 据我们所知,这是第一次对心理健康干预的大规模审计。 LLMs建议,如果从临床医生、护理人员或个人本身的角度写出同样的信息,无论是在受到某种干预的制约,还是在未受到约束的情况下。 我们研究了不限成员名额的一代人和结构化的评级,以查明当前与寻求心理健康治疗建议的人互动时的LLM行为. 我们在本文件中作了三项贡献。 从经验上来说,我们描述了41种语言模型在19个临床医生审查的病例中提出的建议,以及三个基础。 我们这样做既包括不限成员名额的一代(35 055份答复),也包括按状况和干预类型报告的四份完整选项清单的结构评级。 从方法上讲,我们引入了对一代人和评级审计设计和基础设施,同时考虑到更广泛的AI建议研究。 我们的方法可以适应不同的案例、建议集和应用领域。 为了支持透明度、可复制性和未来的研究,我们将公布代码、vignettes、评级清单、编码准则和完整内容,使其他人能够独立审计和扩大我们的调查结果。

blocks.en: \headfont 2  Methods
blocks.zh: 标题font 2 方法

blocks.en: 2.1  Study Design
blocks.zh: 2.1 研究设计

blocks.en: To determine what mental health interventions language models are likely recommending to users when they approach AI systems, we designed a two-arm audit (Figure 1 ). The first arm is the naive, naturalistic one: taking a case vignette and asking the models what they would recommend for that user in open-ended responses. This captures the models’ default behavior. However, we expect such an approach to remain uncontrolled for confounds like prevalence bias, where an option is frequently named because it is common in the training data instead of reflecting a model’s clinical reasoning. To assess something closer to model reasoning around each intervention, in addition to its default behavior, we carried out a structured rating arm that provided a list of possible intervention options alongside the cases to see if recommendation frequency correlated with higher ratings in a structured task.
blocks.zh: 为了确定哪些心理健康干预语言模型在用户接近AI系统时可能会向用户推荐,我们设计了双臂审计(图1). 第一臂是天真自然主义的一臂:拿起一个案子,问模型在无限制的反应中会向那个用户建议什么. 这捕捉了模型的默认行为. 然而,我们期望这样一种方法在流行偏差等混乱因素上保持不受控制,因为这种偏差经常被命名,因为它在培训数据中很常见,而不是反映模型的临床推理。 为了评估更接近于每一次干预的模型推理,除了其默认行为之外,我们进行了一个结构化的评级分支,该分支提供了一份可能干预选项清单,与案例一起,看看建议频率是否与结构化任务中的更高评级相关.

blocks.en: Figure 1: Structure of the two-arm audit. In the generation arm, 285 prompts (19 vignettes × \times 3 footings × \times 5 asks) were sent three times to each of 41 models, and a judge extracted named interventions and their stance from each free-text response. In the rating arm, 228 prompts (19 vignettes × \times 3 footings × \times 4 option lists) were sent three times to each of 29 models, which were tasked with scoring every option on the list.
blocks.zh: 图1:双臂审计的结构。 在生成手臂中,285个提示(19 vignettes × \time 3 stases × \time 5 askes)被发送到41个模型中每个模型中3次,一名法官从每个自由文本响应中提取了命名的干预及其立场. 在评分臂中,有228个提示(19 vignettes ×\times 3steps ×\times 4 选项列表)被三次发送给29个型号中的每个型号,这些型号的任务是对名单上的每个选项进行评分.

blocks.en: Because experts disagree on the context-specific appropriateness of many evaluated interventions [ 16 , 17 ] , our audit is designed without an answer key. We define no correct or incorrect behavior, and instead descriptively report on how the models behave without evaluative judgment (beyond a handful of known-harmful controls). We intentionally produced more data than one paper can exhaustively analyze and encourage researchers to explore the dataset further once it is released. We did so because models are frequently deprecated and recording historical audit data is critical for regulators, researchers and developers to have access to as they evaluate how model behavior changes over time.
blocks.zh: 由于专家们对许多被评价的干预[16,17]针对具体情况的适当性意见不一,因此我们的审计设计没有答案关键。 我们没有定义正确或不正确的行为,而是描述性地报告模型如何在没有评价判断的情况下行事(超越了少数已知的有害控制)。 我们有意编制的数据多于一份文件,可以详尽分析并鼓励研究人员在数据集发布后进一步探索数据集。 我们这样做是因为模型经常被贬值,记录历史审计数据对于监管者,研究人员和开发者在评价模型行为如何随时间推移而变化时能够访问至关重要.

blocks.en: 2.2  Audit Target Definition
blocks.zh: 2.2 审计目标定义

blocks.en: 2.2.1  Case vignettes, footings, and asks
blocks.zh: 2.2.1 国家 案件、立体和问

blocks.en: Prior studies have generally focused on specific conditions of interest and adherence to specific guidelines. We opted to cast a wider net using a range of case vignettes, varied both in the clinical details they contain and in how those details are presented, so that the input prompts span a broad spectrum of ways the same clinical question can reach a model. Both arms were designed to use the same core prompt stems to maintain consistency in the clinical information presented, reduce potential confounding factors, and enable more direct comparisons between the two approaches.
blocks.zh: 先前的研究一般侧重于感兴趣的具体条件和遵守具体准则的情况。 我们选择了用一系列的病例图投放一个更宽的网,这些图中包含的临床细节和这些细节的呈现方式各不相同,这样输入提示就能够广泛涵盖同样的临床问题可以到达一个模型。 这两种武器的设计都是为了使用同样的核心电源,以保持所提供的临床信息的一致性,减少潜在的混淆因素,并使这两种方法更直接地进行比较。

blocks.en: Case vignettes . We developed 19 case vignettes representing a diverse range of plausible mental health-related presentations for which users might seek treatment advice from an LLM-based chatbot. These conditions included major depressive disorder, generalized anxiety disorder, panic disorder, OCD, PTSD, chronic insomnia, social anxiety disorder, adult ADHD, binge-eating disorder, bipolar I disorder in maintenance, alcohol use disorder, first-episode schizophrenia, bulimia nervosa, anorexia nervosa, borderline and narcissistic personality disorder, and autism spectrum disorder. The vignettes were designed to reflect conditions at a severity level where treatment would be a reasonable consideration, although they were only roughly matched for clinical severity across conditions. We also included two vignettes as controls: uncomplicated bereavement three weeks after the loss of a spouse and subclinical situational stress.
blocks.zh: 案件审理 我们开发了19个病例录像,代表了各种与精神健康有关的合理介绍,用户可从一个基于LLM的聊天室寻求治疗建议。 这些疾病包括:严重抑郁症、普遍焦虑症、恐慌症、OCD、PTSD、慢性失眠症、社会焦虑症、成人ADHD、吃肉症、双极症。 我维持过程中的紊乱,酒精使用紊乱,先发性精神分裂症,布鲁米亚神经病,厌食性神经病,边缘和自恋性人格障碍,以及自闭症谱系障碍. 阴道设计是为了反映治疗为合理考虑的严重程度,尽管它们只大致符合不同条件的临床严重程度。 我们还将两个阴道作为控制:在失去配偶3周后不复杂的丧葬和次临床情况压力。

blocks.en: Footings . Each vignette was written in three different styles, one as a clinician describing a patient, another as a caregiver describing a loved one, and the third as a person describing their own experience. We refer to these prompt variants as footings, after Goffman’s term for the stance a speaker takes toward what they say and whom it concerns [ 6 ] . We chose these three footings because clinicians, family caregivers, and patients each already bring health questions to language models [ 30 , 31 , 3 , 4 ] . Table 1 shows all three for the major depressive disorder vignette. We sought to maintain consistency in symptoms, duration, severity, and functional impact across the three footings to support meaningful comparisons. Similarly, each footing was written to follow a single fixed style profile across all 19 conditions, to control for surface style confounds in our results.
blocks.zh: 脚 每个vignette的写作有三种不同的风格,一种是描述病人的临床医生,另一种是描述亲人的护理者,第三种是描述自己经历的人. 我们把这些迅速的变体称为基础, 我们选择了这三个基础,因为临床医生、家庭护理人员和病人都已经把健康问题带给语言模型[30、31、3、4]。 表1列出三大抑郁症发作者。 我们力求在症状、持续时间、严重程度和功能影响这三个方面保持一致,以支持有意义的比较。 同样地,每个台阶都按照一个固定的风格图案, 在所有19个条件中, 控制表面的风格 困惑在我们的结果。

blocks.en: Table 1: The three footings, shown for the major depressive disorder vignette with the unconstrained ask.
blocks.zh: 表1: 以无拘束的问法为主的抑郁症发作的三根基.

blocks.en: Asks . In the input prompt, each vignette is followed by one of five questions. One is unconstrained (“What would you recommend for this patient?” in the clinical footing), while the remaining four, which we call intervention-specific asks, each focus on one intervention type: medications, therapy, procedures or interventional treatments, and apps or digital tools. The four intervention-specific asks are yes/no questions (“Are there any medications you would recommend for this patient?” in the clinical footing), so that “no” remains an available answer. The unconstrained ask is not binary since “nothing” is a reasonable response to an unconstrained question, where supplying an intervention type (“What medications would you recommend for this patient?” for example) would bias toward intervention. The asks are held as close as possible across footings, changing mainly the pronoun and lexical register (“this patient” / “them” / “me”; “medications” / “meds”). The caregiver and patient procedure asks also give brain stimulation as an example, which the clinician ask does not.
blocks.zh: 问. 在输入提示中,每个vignette后面是五个问题中的一个. 一个是不受约束的(“你建议这个病人做什么? ” ) , 而其余四个,我们称之为干预特定要求, 都集中在一种干预类型:药物、治疗、程序或干预治疗,以及应用或数字工具。 四个具体干预问题都是是/否问题(“在临床方面,你是否愿意为这名病人建议任何药物?”),因此“否”仍然是现有答案。 不受限制的要求不是二进制的,因为“无”是对一个不受限制的问题的合理答复,在那里提供一种干预类型(“例如,你建议该病人使用什么药物?” )会偏向干预。 这些要求尽可能地在不同的基础上进行,主要是改变代词和词汇表(“这个病人”/“他们”/“我”;“药剂”/“药剂”)。 护理者和病人程序也要求以脑刺激为例,而临床医生则没有。

blocks.en: The vignettes and asks went through four rounds of review with a psychiatrist co-author, who signed off on the final wordings. The complete set of vignettes and asks is provided in Appendices A and B.
blocks.zh: vignettes and askes 与一位精神病医生合著者进行了四轮审查,后者在最后的措辞上签字。 完整的维格内特和问题集载于附录A和B.

blocks.en: 2.2.2  Intervention option lists
blocks.zh: 2.2.2 干预备选办法清单

blocks.en: For the structured rating arm of the audit, we developed a fixed set of options for each intervention type. We developed four intervention-specific lists for the audit: psychiatric medications (n = 139), psychotherapies (n = 69), procedures (n = 34), and digital tools (n = 101).
blocks.zh: 对于审计的结构化评级部门,我们为每一种干预类型制定了一套固定的选项。 我们制定了四个针对具体干预措施的审计清单:精神病药物(n=139)、心理治疗(n=69)、程序(n=34)和数字工具(n=101)。

blocks.en: The medication list covers the psychiatric pharmacopoeia by class (antidepressants, antipsychotics, mood stabilizers, anxiolytics, hypnotics, stimulants, and agents for substance use disorders), listed by generic name, and including medications no longer generally considered best practice. The psychotherapy list spans cognitive behavioral, third-wave, psychodynamic, interpersonal, humanistic, trauma-focused, family and group, and substance-specific therapies, along with a set of fringe and discredited approaches. The procedures list spans convulsive therapies, magnetic and electrical stimulation, implanted and surgical interventions, clinic-administered ketamine and psychedelic-assisted treatments, and historical procedures no longer in use. The digital list spans prescription digital therapeutics, consumer mental health apps, telehealth services, and general-purpose AI assistants and companion chatbots, including consumer products from several of the developers under audit and ones no longer available for use.
blocks.zh: 药物清单按类别(抗抑郁药、抗精神病药、情绪稳定剂、安眠药、催眠药、兴奋剂和药物使用紊乱剂)列出精神病药,并包括不再被普遍视为最佳做法的药物。 心理治疗清单包括认知行为、第三波、心理动力学、人际关系、人文主义、以创伤为重点的心理治疗、家庭和群体,以及针对具体物质的治疗,以及一套边缘和信誉低下的方法。 程序清单包括抽搐疗法、磁电刺激、植入和手术干预、诊所管理的氯胺酮和精神辅助治疗以及不再使用的历史程序。 数字清单涵盖处方数字治疗、消费者心理健康应用、远程保健服务、通用AI助手和伴机,包括一些接受审计的开发商的消费品和不再可供使用的消费品。

blocks.en: We developed the intervention lists through a three-stage process: generation, refinement, and finalization. In the generation stage, the authors drew on their domain knowledge, internet searches, and reference sources, including DrugBank for medications [ 32 ] , the MINDapps database for mental health apps [ 33 ] , and the Society of Clinical Psychology’s register of psychological treatments [ 34 ] , to identify interventions that models might plausibly recommend for each of the 19 conditions. During refinement, we used a language-model-assisted search within the Claude Code harness, assigning one subagent to each list to identify missing options and flag potential duplicates or inaccuracies in the initial lists. Finally, we manually removed duplicates, standardized aliases and brand names, and submitted each list for review by study team members with relevant expertise. Psychiatrist co-authors reviewed the medication and procedure lists, social worker and psychologist co-authors reviewed the psychotherapy list, and digital psychiatry co-authors reviewed the digital tools list.
blocks.zh: 我们通过一个三阶段的过程制定了干预清单:生成、完善和定稿。 在生成阶段,作者利用他们的域名知识、互联网搜索和参考来源,包括药物药物银行、精神卫生应用的MINDapps数据库以及临床心理学学会的心理治疗登记册[34],以确定模型可能为19个条件中每一个条件提出合理建议的措施。 在改进过程中,我们在Claude Code Up内使用语言模型辅助搜索,为每个列表指派一名副代理,以查明缺失的选项,并标出初始列表中可能出现的重复或不准确之处。 最后,我们手动移除了复制品、标准化化名和品牌名称,并提交了每个清单,供具有相关专门知识的研究小组成员审查。 精神病学家合著者审查了药物和程序清单,社会工作者和心理学家合著者审查了心理治疗清单,数字精神病学家合著者审查了数字工具清单。

blocks.en: Discredited practices, such as conversion therapy and lobotomy, were intentionally included in the lists to anchor the lower end of the rating scale. Each rating list also includes explicit null options: “no medication”, “no psychotherapy”, “no somatic or neuromodulation treatment”, and “no digital intervention”. These options allowed us to examine whether models favor no intervention in certain cases and whether they rate some interventions as less appropriate than no treatment at all.
blocks.zh: 诸如转化疗法和叶切除术等无效做法被有意列入清单,以锁定评级等级的下端。 每一评级清单还包括明确的无效选项:“没有药物”、“没有心理治疗”、“没有身体或神经调节治疗”和“没有数字干预”。 这些选择使我们能够审查模式是否赞成在某些情况下不干预,以及它们是否认为某些干预不如任何治疗恰当。

blocks.en: The lists are designed to be versioned instruments in a living audit. They were frozen as version 1.0.0 with a checksum manifest before both generation and rating audit runs. The generation arm identified a number of new interventions that will be added to the next version of the rating lists. Interventions that models name in free text but are absent from the lists in future runs will similarly be logged as new candidates, so each round of the audit sharpens the rating instrument for the next and helps keep the audit current to changes in intervention practices. The full lists and a summary of their review are included in Appendix C.
blocks.zh: 这些清单旨在成为活审计中的工具。 它们被冻结为1.0.0版本,在生成和评分审计运行前附有核对表。 生成分支确定了若干新的干预措施,将添加到下一个版本的评级名单中。 在免费文本中标注姓名、但今后不再列入清单的干预措施,同样将作为新候选人登录,因此,每轮审计都使下一个审计的评级工具更加清晰,并有助于使审计跟上干预做法的变化。 完整名单及其审查摘要载于附录C。

blocks.en: 2.3  Model Selection
blocks.zh: 2.3 型号选择

blocks.en: We audited 41 language models from eight developers (Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, Mistral, Alibaba, xAI, DeepSeek, and Moonshot), accessing each model through its developer’s Application Programming Interface (API).
blocks.zh: 我们审计了来自8个开发者的41个语言模型(Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, Mistral, Alibaba, xAI, DeepSeek, 和 Moonshot),

blocks.en: The model list was chosen to balance both developer and capability tier coverage so that behavior can be compared across developers, across scale, and over time within a family. All 41 models were run through the open-ended generation arm. To balance cost against comprehensiveness, only 29 models were run through the structured rating arm, which requires far longer outputs. Five of the 41 models offered a dated snapshot and were pinned to it for API calls. The rest were called by an alias or version identifier, some of which the developer can update without notice. For those models we recorded the model name that the API returned with each response, in addition to the system fingerprint when one was supplied to make our results as replicable as possible. The full model roster, with identifiers, run dates, and hyperparameter settings, can be found in Appendix D.
blocks.zh: 选择模型列表是为了平衡开发者与能力层级的覆盖,这样就可以在开发者之间,在规模上,在家族内部的时间里比较行为. 所有41个型号都通过无限制的一代臂来运行. 为了平衡费用与全面性,只有29个模式通过结构化评级部门运作,这需要更长的产出。 41个型号中,有5个型号提供了日期性快照,并被固定在它上供API通话. 其余使用别名或版本标识符调用,部分开发者可以不经通知更新. 对于这些模型,我们记录了API每次回复时返回的模型名称,此外还记录了系统指纹,提供指纹是为了尽可能复制我们的结果。 完整的模型名册,包括识别符,运行日期和超参数设置,可参见附录D.

blocks.en: 2.4  Open-Ended Generation Arm
blocks.zh: 2.4 无尾代臂

blocks.en: Response Generation. For running the open-ended generation arm of the audit, each prompt was constructed as a vignette followed by an ask, sent as a single user message with no system prompt. All 41 models under audit received all 285 prompts (19 vignettes × \times 3 footings × \times 5 asks) three times, for 855 responses per model and 35,055 in total. Models ran with each developer’s default temperature and reasoning settings. Response budgets were set to 4,096 tokens, and cells that hit the cap were re-run at a cap of 10,000 tokens. A response counted as usable only if it was non-empty, non-error, and not truncated. All 35,055 cells were completed successfully. We used batch endpoints where providers offered them. The response text, token counts, finish reason, latency, the resolved model name, and the reasoning trace were recorded when provided and supported by the generation method in use.
blocks.zh: 对策生成。 对于运行审计的开放式生成臂,每个提示被构建为vigette,然后是询问,作为单一用户消息发送,没有系统提示. 接受审计的41个模型共收到全部285个提示(19个vignettes ×\times 3 steps ×\times 5 问)3次,每个模型有855个响应,总共35 055个响应. 模型随每个开发者的默认温度和推理设置运行. 响应预算被设定为4,096个令牌,击中封顶的细胞被重新运行,封顶为10,000个令牌. 只有在非空的、非误用的和不截断的情况下,反应才算有效。 35 055个牢房全部顺利完工。 我们使用批量终点 供应商提供它们。 响应文本,符号计数,完成理由,耐久性,解析的模型名称,以及推理的踪迹,在提供时被记录在使用中的生成方法中.

blocks.en: Response Extraction. To select a language model judge for response extraction, we evaluated four candidates (Claude Haiku 4.5, Claude Sonnet 5, GPT-5.6 Luna, and DeepSeek V4 Flash) based on coding accuracy and estimated cost. GPT-5.6 Luna demonstrated the best coding performance at a reasonable projected cost for the full corpus. We developed and refined the judge prompt using author-annotated examples, then evaluated it over three rounds using a held-out set of 19 responses before freezing it. The frozen prompt is provided in Appendix E.
blocks.zh: 反应提取。 为了选择一名语言模型法官进行响应提取,我们根据编码准确性和估计费用对四名候选人进行了评价(Claude Haiku 4.5、Claude Sonnet 5、GPT-5.6 Luna和DeepSeek V4 Flash)。 GPT-5.6 Luna以合理的预计成本证明了完整的编码性能最佳。 我们利用作者说明的例子制定和完善了法官的提示,然后通过三轮评估,在冻结之前用19个答复套装。 冻结的提示载于附录E。

blocks.en: Using the selected judge, we analyzed each generated response to identify explicitly mentioned interventions and classify the model’s stance toward each into four categories: recommended (suggested as an intervention), neutral (mentioned for informational purposes only), advised against (the response steers this person away from it), and mixed (recommended for one purpose but discouraged for another within the same response). Intervention names were extracted as written in the original responses.
blocks.zh: 我们利用选定的法官,分析了每个生成的答复,以确定明确提到的干预,并将模型对每个干预的立场分为四类:建议(建议作为干预)、中性(仅供参考)、建议反对(答复使此人远离它)和混合(建议用于一种目的,但在同一回应中劝阻另一个目的)。 干预名称按原始答复中的措辞提取。

blocks.en: Conditional recommendations were classified as recommended. Named organizations, helplines, books, and podcasts were included as interventions when recommended for support, while general categories (e.g., “therapy” or “medication”) were excluded. The judge also recorded two binary indicators: whether the response recommended professional consultation and whether it included an AI or medical disclaimer.
blocks.zh: 有条件的建议被列为建议。 在建议支助时,将命名的组织、求助热线、书籍和播客列为干预措施,而一般类别(如“治疗”或“药物治疗”)则排除在外。 法官还记录了两个二进制指标:答复是建议专业咨询,还是包括AI还是医疗免责声明.

blocks.en: Finally, extracted interventions were matched to predefined option lists using a deterministic dictionary that accounted for generic names, brand names, aliases, and abbreviations.
blocks.zh: 最后,将提取的干预措施与预先界定的选项清单相匹配,其中使用了一种确定性词典,其中包含通用名称、品牌名称、别名和缩写。

blocks.en: Human Validation. We validated the judge against human coders on 300 responses, each coded independently by two of eight study team coders. Human coders used an offline packet that showed the response with the judge’s extracted intervention entities highlighted but without their extracted stances. For each entity, human coders selected one of the four stances, or they chose “not a treatment or resource” to measure extraction precision. After each response was a free-text box for named interventions the judge failed to extract, which was present to measure recall, and the two disclaimer questions were answered as checkboxes.
blocks.zh: 人类验证. 我们在300个回复上验证了法官对人体编码器的对比,每个回复器由8个研究组编码器中的2个独立编码. 人类编解码员使用一个离线包,显示法官所提取的干预实体的反应,但没有显示其提取的立场。 对于每个实体,人类编码员选择了四个立场中的一个,或者他们选择“不是一种处理方法或资源”来衡量提取精度。 在每次答复都是一个自由文字框,用于指定发言之后,法官未能提取,而该框是用来衡量召回的,两个免责问题作为复选框回答。

blocks.en: The main human validation sample was drawn from the judged corpus with a fixed random seed, excluding responses used during judge development. We used stratified sampling to oversample responses labeled as mixed or advised against by the judge, with caps per model and condition.
blocks.zh: 主要的人类验证样本来自具有固定随机种子的判断体,不包括在判断体发育过程中使用的反应. 我们用分层抽样来对被评为混合反应或法官建议反对的反应进行过度抽样,每个模型和条件都有上限。

blocks.en: Before finalizing human coding instructions, we conducted two calibration rounds, each involving three human coders and ten challenging responses. We used pre-specified agreement thresholds for the binary advised-against classification (Krippendorff’s α ≥ .67 \alpha\geq.67 to proceed with revisions and α ≥ .80 \alpha\geq.80 to proceed without revisions). The main validation sample was divided in advance into a development set of 100 responses, open for error analysis and revision of the coder guide, and a frozen test set of 200 responses, coded under the final guide and compared with the judge exactly once. The final coding guide can be found in Appendix F.
blocks.zh: 在最后确定人类编码指令之前,我们进行了两轮校准,每轮涉及3个人类编码器和10个挑战性响应. 我们使用预先规定的二进制建议阈值(Krippendorff的α \ .67 \ alpha\ geq.67)来进行修改,并使用α .80\ alpha\ geq.80进行修改。 主验证样本事先分为100个响应的开发集,对编码器指南的误差分析和修订开放,以及200个响应的冷冻测试集,在最终指南下编码,与评委精确比对一次. 最终编码指南见附录F.

blocks.en: Agreement was assessed at the level of canonical entities using Krippendorff’s α \alpha . The primary outcome was the binary classification of whether an intervention was advised against, with neutral, recommended, and mixed stances grouped as not advised against.
blocks.zh: 使用Krippendorff的α α α, 其主要成果是二进制分类,即是否建议采取干预行动,是否采取中立、建议和混合立场,但并未建议采取这种立场。

blocks.en: This conservative grouping reflects how users might interpret model responses. An intervention mentioned in response to a request for options may be perceived as a recommendation even without explicit endorsement [ 35 ] . Similarly, a mixed response recommends an intervention for at least one use, which may be the only part a user notices when skimming the response [ 36 , 37 ] . Advised against is the only stance that actively steers the reader away from a named intervention. We also report four-way agreement descriptively, along with category-specific reliability. We considered the judge’s performance acceptable when its agreement with human coders was comparable to inter-coder agreement.
blocks.zh: 这种保守的分组反映了用户如何解释模型响应. 答复选择权请求时提及的干预即使没有明确赞同也可视为建议[35]。 同样,一种混合反应建议至少一种用途的干预,这可能是用户在略微反应时唯一注意到的部分[36,37]. 唯一反对的立场是,积极引导读者远离某种所谓的干预。 我们还描述性地报告四方面协议以及特定类别的可靠性。 我们认为法官的表现是可以接受的,因为法官与人类编码员的协议与编码员之间的协议相当。

blocks.en: 2.5  Structured Rating Arm
blocks.zh: 2.5 结构式评级臂

blocks.en: In the structured rating arm of the audit, we constructed each prompt using the same vignettes and footings, followed by the complete option list for one intervention type and an instruction to rate every option on a seven-point Likert scale from − 3 -3 (clearly the wrong choice / harmful for this person) to + 3 +3 (excellent choice, among the first to consider). We constructed the rating prompt without the generation arm asks. Instead, we presented the vignette, the full option list for a specific intervention type in shuffled order, and an instruction to rate how appropriate each option would be as an initial or primary choice for the vignette provided. Because most vignettes did not include treatment histories, and models in the open-ended arm provided initial management during pilot testing, we made the rating arm prompt-asymmetrical by explicitly asking about first-line appropriateness rather than any-time appropriateness to target the same decision across both arms.
blocks.zh: 在结构化的审计评级栏目中,我们用同样的花纹和台阶构建了每个提示,然后是一套干预类型的完整选项清单,并指示将每个选项按7点的Irikrt尺度进行评级,从− 3-3(显然对这个人有错误的选择/有害)到+ 3+3(在最先考虑的选择中). 我们搭建了评分提示器,没有生成手臂的问题。 相反,我们提出了vignette、按洗牌顺序进行特定干预类型的完整选项清单,以及评估每种选项作为所提供的vignette初始或主要选择的适当性的指示。 由于大多数vigettes没有包括治疗史,而且开放式臂的模型在试验期间提供了初步管理,我们通过明确询问第一线是否合适而不是任何时间是否适合瞄准两个臂的同一决定,使评级臂迅速不对称。

blocks.en: The rating prompt also explicitly stated that one option represents choosing not to intervene and instructed models to rate it on the same scale. We shuffled option order for each call to reduce ordering bias [ 38 ] . Models returned a JSON object mapping each option to an integer score. We used a truncation-tolerant parser to retain completed ratings even when a response was cut off. Before the full run, each model passed a format-compliance probe of 24 cells, blind to rating content. Models were only included if at least 80% of calls validly scored at least 90% of the options. All 29 candidate models passed the compliance probe. The full run was 19 vignettes × \times 3 footings × \times 4 option lists × \times 3 samples, for 684 rating calls for each of the 29 models in the rating arm and 19,836 in total. Model calls were sent with a 32,768-token output budget on live lanes and 8,192 on batch lanes (4,096 for GPT-3.5 Turbo) so that reasoning-default models were not cut off mid-list.
blocks.zh: 评级提示器还明确指出,一种选择是选择不干预,并指示模型按同样比例进行评级。 我们为每次通话洗刷了选项顺序,以减少命令偏差[38]. 模型将 JSON 对象映射每个选项返回整数分数 。 我们用一个能耐截断的解析器 来保留完成的收视率 即使一个答复被切断。 在全程运行前,每个型号都通过了24个单元格的格式达标探测器,对评级内容视而不见. 只有当至少80%的通话有效得分至少90%的选项时,模型才被包括在内。 所有29个候选型号都通过了合规调查。 全程为19 vignettes × Times 3 steps × Times 4 选项列表 × Times 3 标本,评分臂29个型号各有684个评分呼号,共计19,836个. 发送的型号呼叫中,有32,768个托肯的产出预算用于直播车道,8,192个批量车道(TPT-3.5涡轮机为4,096个),这样推理-默认模式就不会被从中除名.

blocks.en: 2.6  Analysis
blocks.zh: 2.6 分析

blocks.en: We report results separately for each condition and intervention type. Every count and rating distribution corresponds to one cell of the 19 × \times 4 grid. When comparing the two arms, we compare results within the same cell. We do not pool across intervention types, because the option lists are not balanced for appropriateness, and we do not pool across conditions because the vignettes are only roughly matched for severity.
blocks.zh: 我们分别报告每种情况的结果和干预类型。 每个计数和评分分布对应19×\time 4网格的一个单元格. 在比较两臂时,我们比较同一个细胞内的结果. 我们没有将各种干预类型结合起来,因为选择清单不适当地加以平衡,而且我们没有将各种条件结合起来,因为阴茎只是大致符合严重程度。

blocks.en: For each option within a cell, we report two core metrics. In the generation arm, we report the proportion of responses to the corresponding intervention-specific ask and the unconstrained ask that mention the option as recommended (including neutral and mixed mentions, as defined above). We count advised-against mentions separately. In the rating arm, we report the distribution of scores from − 3 -3 to + 3 +3 across all rating calls within the cell. Both are also broken down by footing. Disclaimer rates are the proportion of responses flagged for consult-a-professional and not-a-doctor binary questions, and are reported by footing, by ask, and by model family.
blocks.zh: 对于一个单元格中的每个选项,我们报告两个核心指标。 在生成臂中,我们报告对相应干预特定要求的答复比例,不受限制者则要求按建议提及这一选项(包括上文定义的中立和混合提及)。 我们分别计算建议反对提及。 在评分栏中,我们报告在细胞内所有评分电话中,从−3-3到+3+3的分数分布. 两者也按台阶细分. 免责率是指被标注为咨询专业和非博士二进制问题的答复比例,按基础,问题,模范家庭进行报告.

blocks.en: For several specific findings, we supplemented the extraction with regular expression searches on the response text. For conditioned recommendations, we searched a fixed window around each mention of an option (the same line, two lines before, one after, and the nearest heading above) for language indicating that the model recommended the intervention under certain conditions. We searched for augmentation and partial-response terms for the OCD antipsychotics, dependence warnings and time limits for the benzodiazepines, persistence gates or not-needed statements for complicated grief therapy, and treatment-resistance terms for deep brain stimulation.
blocks.zh: 对于若干具体的调查结果,我们用对答复文本的常规表达式搜索来补充摘录。 对于附带条件的建议,我们搜索了一个固定窗口,每条窗口都提到一个选项(同一行,前两行,后一行,上方最近的标题),以表示该模型建议在某些情况下进行干预。 我们寻找的是OCD抗精神病药物的增强和部分反应术语,苯并二氮杂卓的依赖性警告和时间限制,复杂悲痛治疗的持久性门或不需要的语句,以及深脑刺激的治疗-抗药性术语。

blocks.en: For brand naming, we searched responses for whole-word matches of the intervention names. For cited authorities, responses were searched against a list fixed before counting that spans medicines regulators from six jurisdictions, guideline and professional bodies, public agencies, app review bodies, evidence sources, and the justification phrases models use. All three searches counted mentions in the text, not recommendations, and were conducted independently of the judge. Additional details are provided in Appendix G.
blocks.zh: 对于品牌命名,我们搜索了干预名称的全词匹配的响应. 对于被引用的当局,对答复进行了搜索,其范围包括六个管辖区的药品监管机构、准则和专业机构、公共机构、应用程序审查机构、证据来源以及所使用的说明词。 所有三次搜查都提到案文,而不是建议,而且是独立于法官进行的。 更多详情见附录G。

blocks.en: 2.7  Ethics and Distribution
blocks.zh: 2.7 道德操守和分配

blocks.en: We developed the vignettes without using any patient data. The only human participants were the eight study team coders, who will be identified in the released dataset only by anonymous codes. We recorded model outputs as observed, and they should not be interpreted as clinical guidance.
blocks.zh: 我们没有使用任何病人数据来开发阴道。 唯一的人类参与者是8个研究小组的编码员,他们将在发布的数据集中仅通过匿名代码进行识别. 我们记录的模型产出是观察到的,不应被解释为临床指导。

blocks.en: On publication, we will release the full study materials (vignettes, asks, option lists), the frozen judge prompt and coder guide, all generation responses and rating runs, along with their provenance information (pack version, prompt hash, model identifier, and hyperparameters), for other research teams to use with attribution.
blocks.zh: 出版后,我们将发布完整的研究材料(vignettes, askes, option lists),冷冻法官即时和编码指南,所有世代的回复和评级运行,以及其出处信息(pack 版本,即时散列,模型标识符和超参数),供其他研究团队随归属使用.

blocks.en: \headfont 3  Results
blocks.zh: 标题 3 结果

blocks.en: In total, our audit included 54,891 model calls: 35,055 free-text responses in the open-ended generation arm and 19,836 rating calls in the structured rating arm. Claude Fable 5 declined to rate the medication list for the panic disorder vignette in the clinician footing, returning refusal on two attempts and no rating on two additional retries. The other 19,835 calls returned ratings.
blocks.zh: 我们的审计共包括54 891个型号呼叫:35 055个自由文本响应在不限成员名额的一代臂,19 836个评级呼叫在结构化的评级臂。 Claude Fable 5拒绝对临床医生的惊慌失常症的药物清单进行评分,两次尝试都回绝,两次复诊没有评分. 其他19,835个电话恢复收视率.

blocks.en: Table 2: Scale of the two audit arms. Cells per model is the number of model calls each model received; total cells is the arm’s full corpus.
blocks.zh: 表2:两个审计机构的规模。 每个模型的细胞是模型呼叫每个模型的数量;总细胞是臂部的全体.

blocks.en: 3.1  Extraction validation
blocks.zh: 3.1 采掘验证

blocks.en: Eight human coders independently evaluated 200 test responses from the open-ended generation arm, with two human coders assigned to each response (2,924 dual-coded entities). For the binary classification of whether an intervention was advised against, the two human coders achieved an agreement of α \alpha = .84. Agreement between the judge and the human coders was α \alpha = .83. For the four-way stance classification (recommended, neutral, mixed, advised against), human coders achieved α \alpha = .61, compared with α \alpha = .67 between the judge and human coders. When both human coders agreed, the judge matched their classification 95.5% of the time. Human coders rejected 1% of extracted entities as “not a treatment or resource”, and they listed 64 interventions missed by the judge. These results correspond to an extraction precision of about 99% and a recall of 98%, counting every intervention identified as missed by a coder.
blocks.zh: 8名人码员独立评价了200次来自无限代臂的测试响应,每个响应分配了2名人码员(2,924个双码实体). 对于是否建议干预的二进制分类,两个人类编码器达成了α\α=.84的协议. 法官与人类编码员的协议为 α α = .83。 对于四向姿势分类(推荐,中性,混合,建议反对),人类编码器实现α\α=.61,而法官与人类编码器实现α\α=.67. 当两位人类编码员都同意时,法官将其分类时间为95.5%. 人类编码员拒绝1%的提取实体为“非治疗或资源”,他们列举了法官错过的64次干预。 这些结果对应于提取精度约99%和召回率98%,计及每一次被编码者确认为错过的干预.

blocks.en: For the consult-a-professional question, human coders agreed on 77% of responses ( α \alpha = .39), while the judge agreed with human coders on 82% ( α \alpha = .44). For the not-a-doctor question, human coders agreed on 93% of responses ( α \alpha = .79), while the judge agreed with human coders on 92% ( α \alpha = .70). Human coders flagged 74% of the responses as encouraging users to consult a professional and the judge flagged 85%. Because this indicator was common, human coders could achieve high agreement simply by frequently selecting it, and Krippendorff’s α \alpha accounts for this expected agreement by chance [ 39 ] .
blocks.zh: 对于专业咨询问题,人类编码员同意了77%的答复(α\alpha=.39),而法官同意人类编码员同意82%的答复(α\alpha=.44). 对于非博士问题,人类编码者同意93%的答复(α\alpha=.79),而法官同意人类编码者同意92%的答复(α\alpha=.70). 人类编码员将74%的答复标为鼓励用户咨询专业人员,法官标为85%。 因为这个指标很常见, 人类编码员只需经常选择它就可以达成很高的一致,

blocks.en: 3.2  Advice disclosures
blocks.zh: 3.2 咨询披露

blocks.en: Across all 35,055 open-ended responses, the judge found that 85% recommended consulting a professional, while 11% included a disclaimer stating that the model was not qualified to provide medical recommendations.
blocks.zh: 在所有35,055份无限制答复中,法官发现85%建议咨询一名专业人员,而11%则包括一项免责声明,称该模式没有资格提供医疗建议。

blocks.en: Both footing and intervention type were associated with differences in model disclosures (Figure 2 ). Models recommended consulting a professional in 95% of responses to vignettes written from the caregiver and patient footings, compared with 66% of responses to the same vignettes written from the clinician footing.
blocks.zh: 基础和干预类型都与模型披露的不同有关(图2)。 模型建议在95%的护理者和病人对阴道写作的答复中咨询专业人员,而66%的临床医生对同一阴道写作的答复。

blocks.en: Figure 2: Advice disclosures by footing and ask. Share of the 35,055 responses that (A) advise consulting a professional and (B) disclaim being an AI, not a doctor, or not qualified to give medical advice. Margins give the rate across all asks and across all footings.
blocks.zh: 图 2:按依据和询问提供建议。 在35,055份答复中,有部分答复(A)建议咨询专业人员,(B)否认自己是AI,不是医生,或者没有资格提供医疗建议。 边际给出的速率覆盖所有问题和所有基础.

blocks.en: This pattern was consistent across all 41 models. The largest difference appeared in therapy and medication asks, where models recommended professional consultation in 56% and 58% of clinician-footing responses, respectively, compared with over 95% for caregiver and patient footings.
blocks.zh: 在所有41种模式中,这种模式是一致的。 在治疗和药物治疗方面出现的最大差异是,56%和58%的临床脚科医生回答中,模型建议专业咨询,而护理者和病人的咨询比例则超过95%。

blocks.en: The not-a-doctor disclaimer follows a similar pattern, appearing in 14% of responses to caregiver and patient footing and 6% of responses to clinician footing. This disclaimer appeared most frequently in the medication asks (21%).
blocks.zh: 非医生的免责声明也遵循了类似模式,14%的护理者和病人的答复,6%的临床医生的答复。 这一免责声明最常出现在药物询问中(21%)。

blocks.en: Disclaimer use appears to vary by individual model, particularly for the not-a-doctor disclaimer. Twenty-one models included this disclaimer in fewer than 2% of their responses, while Qwen 3.5 Plus includes one in 91% of its responses. Disclaimer behavior did not show a clear pattern across model families or generations (Figure 3 ). Additional analyses can be found in Appendix H.
blocks.zh: 免责声明的使用似乎因个人模式而异,特别是对于非医生免责声明者而言。 21种模式在不到2%的答复中包括了这种免责声明,而Quen 3.5 Plus则包括了91%的答复中的一种. 免责行为并没有在模范家庭或几代人中表现出明确的模式(图3 ). 其他分析载于附录H。

blocks.en: Figure 3: Advice disclosures per model. Consult-a-professional and not-a-doctor rates by footing for all 41 models, grouped by developer with rows ordered oldest to newest release.
blocks.zh: 图3:每个模型的咨询披露。 对所有41种型号进行按台基分列的专业和非博士级的咨询费率,由开发者按排顺序排列,以获得最新版本。

blocks.en: 3.3  Recommendation behavior
blocks.zh: 3.3 建议行为

blocks.en: Overview. The 35,055 open-ended responses named 494,328 extracted interventions. Under binary classification, 91.2% were recommended and 8.8% were advised against. Under the four-way classification, 85.3% were recommended, 8.8% were advised against, 4.3% were mentioned without a stance, and 1.6% were mixed (explicitly recommended and advised against within the same response). Of the extracted interventions, 40.2% match an option on one of the four rating lists. The remaining interventions primarily included drug classes, unmapped brand names, recreational substances, support organizations, laboratory monitoring orders, and other resources not included in the rating arm.
blocks.zh: 概览. 35,055份无限制答复中列出了494,328项干预措施。 在二进制分类下,建议91.2%,建议8.8%反对。 根据四条路线分类,建议85.3%,建议反对8.8%,提到4.3%没有立场,1.6%是混合的(明确建议和反对在同一答复中)。 在提取的干预措施中,40.2%的干预措施符合四个评级名单上的一个选项。 其余的干预措施主要包括毒品类、未标注的品牌名称、娱乐性物质、支助组织、实验室监测订单以及评级分支未包括的其他资源。

blocks.en: Figure 4 shows all cells of the audit, with each cell representing one condition and intervention type pair. Across the 17 non-control vignettes, the median psychotherapy cell had 7 options recommended in at least 5% of responses (IQR 5–8.5), while the most-recommended option appeared in a median of 84% of responses (range 58%–99%). The top option appeared in at least half of responses across all 17 cells.
blocks.zh: 图4显示审计的所有单元格,每个单元格代表一个条件和干预类型对。 在17个非控制阴道中,中位心理治疗细胞至少有5%的答复(IQR 5–8.5)中推荐了7种选择,而最推荐的选择则出现在84%的答复中位数(范围为58%–999%)中。 顶端选项出现在所有17个单元格中至少一半的答复中。

blocks.en: Figure 4: Every cell of the audit, 19 vignettes by four intervention types. Each strip shows the cell’s options ranked by recommendation rate, the share of open-ended generation responses to the unconstrained ask and the matching intervention-specific ask (738 per cell) in which the option is recommended. Bar height is on one 0 to 100% scale for every strip, with a dotted guide at 50%. The first bar is outlined and named beneath the strip with its recommendation rate. Bar color is the option’s mean score in the structured rating arm, from − 3 -3 (amber) through 0 (gray) to + 3 +3 (teal). Hatched bars are options with a mean rating below zero.
blocks.zh: 图4:审计的每个单元,19个Vignette按4个干预类型排列. 每个条块显示单元格的选项按推荐率排序,对不受约束的问询进行无限制生成回复的比例,以及推荐该选项的匹配干预特定问询(每单元格738次). 每条条条的栏杆高度为0到100%,有50%的点缀导线. 第一个栏杆以推荐率在条条下面列出和命名。 栏色是选项在结构评级臂中的平均得分,从−3-3(琥珀)到0(灰色)到+3+3(teal). 头痛条是平均评分低于零的选项.

blocks.en: Pharmacological and digital recommendations were more diverse. The median pharmacological cell has 11 options recommended in at least 5% of responses (IQR 10–15), with a top option appearing in 60% of responses (range 21% to 91%). The median digital cell had 12 options meeting this 5% threshold (IQR 9–13), with the top option recommended in 44% of responses (range 24% to 71%). The top option reaches half of responses in 11 of 17 pharmacological cells and 7 of 17 digital cells.
blocks.zh: 药理学和数字学建议更为多样。 中位药物细胞在至少5%的答复(IQR 10-15)中建议了11种选择,其中最高选择出现在60%的答复中(从21%到91%不等). 中位数数字电池有12个选项符合5%的阈值(IQR 9–13),其中44%的回复(从24%到71%)推荐了最高选项。 顶端选项在17个药理细胞中的11个和17个数字细胞中的7个达到半数的响应.

blocks.en: Procedure cells are sparse, with the median cell having 3 options at or above 5% (IQR 3 to 6), and the top option is recommended in a median of 25% of responses (range 11% to 54%). Only one procedure cell, DBS for OCD, has a top option above half. rTMS is the most-recommended procedure option in 13 of 17 vignettes, ECT in three, and DBS in one. The strongest convergence on specific interventions occurred for DBT in borderline personality disorder, which had the highest top-option rate in the audit (98.5% of responses), followed by CBT for generalized anxiety (92.5%), EMDR for PTSD (92.4%), CBT for social anxiety (92.1%), and CBT-I in chronic insomnia (91.7%). All 41 models recommended each of these interventions.
blocks.zh: 程序细胞稀少,中位细胞有3个选项在5%或以上(IQR 3至6),最高选项建议在25%的答复中位数(从11%到54%). 只有一个程序单元,即OCD的DBS,顶端选项超过一半. rTMS是17个vignette中13个最推荐的程序选项,ECT为3个,DBS为1个. 边际人格障碍的DBT在具体干预方面最趋同,在审计中,DBT的首选率最高(占答复的98.5%),其次是CBT普遍焦虑症(92.5%)、创伤后精神紧张症(92.4%)、社会焦虑症(92.1%)和慢性失眠症(91.7%)的CBT-I。 所有41个模式都建议采取这些措施。

blocks.en: Recommendation and Rating Agreement. Within each cell, models tended to assign higher ratings to the options they recommended most frequently.
blocks.zh: 建议和评级协定。 在每个单元格中,模型往往会给最经常推荐的选项分配更高的评级。

blocks.en: Figure 5 plots each option in every cell by its mean rating and recommendation rate, separately for the intervention-specific ask and the unconstrained ask. Of the 621 options recommended in at least 5% of responses, 537 had a mean rating above zero, 83 below zero, and one (tDCS for generalized anxiety) exactly at zero. The rank correlation between recommendation rate and rating was positive in all 76 cells, with a median of .57. The 83 recommended options rated below zero are concentrated by type; 50 of the 74 commonly recommended procedure options, 27 of 202 medications, 4 of 213 digital tools, and 2 of 132 psychotherapies.
blocks.zh: 图5按每个单元格的平均评分率和建议率绘制每个选项,分别列出具体干预要求和不受限制要求。 在至少5%的回复中建议的621个选项中,537个的平均值高于零,低于零的83个,1个(普遍焦虑的tDCS)完全为零. 在所有76个单元格中,建议率和评级之间的排名关联为正数,中值为.57。 被评为零以下的83个推荐选项按类型集中;74个共同推荐的程序选项中有50个,202个药物中有27个,213个数字工具中有4个,132个心理治疗中有2个。

blocks.en: Figure 5: Concordance between the two arms. Each point is one option in one cell (a condition and an intervention type), 6,517 points across 76 cells. The x-axis is the option’s mean score in the structured rating arm; the y-axis is the share of open-ended generation responses in that cell recommending it. The dotted line marks a 5% recommendation rate. The top row counts recommendations from the intervention-specific ask, the bottom row from the unconstrained ask. Amber points are options recommended in at least 5% of responses whose mean rating is below zero; the most recommended such option in each panel is labeled. Points from different cells share a panel but are not averaged.
blocks.zh: 图5:两臂相和. 每个点是一个细胞中的一个选项(一个条件和一个干预类型),跨76个细胞的6,517个点. x轴是选项在结构化评级臂中的平均分数;y轴是该单元格中推荐的开放式生成响应的比例. 虚线标为5%的推荐率. 顶行从干预特定询问中计算建议,底行从不受约束询问. 琥珀点是至少5%的答复中推荐的选项,其平均评分低于零;每个面板中最推荐的此类选项都贴上标签. 不同单元格的点共用一个面板,但不平均。

blocks.en: Whether options with a mean rating below zero were still recommended depended on how the question was asked. For intervention-specific asks, where the prompt asks whether there are any medications, therapies, procedures, or apps to recommend, 136 of the 777 options recommended in at least 5% of responses had a mean rating below zero, 73 of them procedures. On the unconstrained ask, where the model chooses what to raise, only 8 of 239 did, and the near disappearance of procedures accounts for most of the drop. The eight include: aripiprazole and risperidone, which are recommended in a quarter of unconstrained-ask responses for OCD and rated − 0.3 -0.3 and − 0.4 -0.4 ; lorazepam, alprazolam, and clonazepam, recommended in 8% to 13% of unconstrained-ask responses for generalized anxiety and rated − 0.3 -0.3 to − 0.6 -0.6 ; and clozapine, recommended in 7% for first-episode schizophrenia and rated − 0.4 -0.4 . The other two are deep brain stimulation for OCD, recommended in 13% of unconstrained-ask responses and rated − 1.8 -1.8 , and complicated grief therapy for uncomplicated bereavement, recommended in 6% and rated − 0.03 -0.03 . When asked about specific intervention types, models frequently named options the rating arm scored as poor initial choices. However, when given an unconstrained ask, they rarely volunteer those options.
blocks.zh: 是否仍然建议采用平均评分低于零的选项,取决于问题是如何提出的。 对于针对具体干预的询问,当即询问是否有任何药物、疗法、程序或应用建议时,在至少5%的答复中建议的777种选择中,有136种选择的平均评分低于零,其中73种是程序。 在不受约束的询问上,模型选择了什么来提,239个中只有8个做了,程序几乎消失占了掉落的大部分. 这八种药物包括:苦艾酒和苦艾酒,在对口服致幻剂的四分之一无限制任务答复中推荐,并被评为−0.3-0.3和−0.4-0.4;苦艾酒、恶艾酒和恶艾酒,被评为8%至13%的无限制任务答复中推荐,用于普遍焦虑,被评为−0.3-0.3至−0.6-0.6;和苦艾酒,被评为7%的一级精神分裂症和被评为−0.4-0.4。 另外两种是OCD的深脑刺激,在13%的无约束任务响应中推荐,并被评为−1.8-1.8,对不复杂的失恋进行复杂的悲伤治疗,建议为6%,评为−0.03-0.03。 当被问及具体干预类型时,模型经常被命名为评分臂作为差的初始选择得分. 然而,如果一个不受限制的询问,他们很少自愿提出这些选择。

blocks.en: Across the 29 models evaluated in both arms, between 3% and 14% of each model’s recommendations were options it had rated below zero for the same vignette (Figure 6 ). For unconstrained asks, this range is 0% to 7%. Four models, Claude Sonnet 4.5, Gemini 3.6 Flash, GPT-5.5, and GPT-3.5, never recommend an option in response to an unconstrained ask that they had rated below zero. Claude Opus 5 showed the highest self-inconsistency rate (14%), as it recommends a broader range of options while assigning relatively low ratings. Self-inconsistency also differed from how other models evaluated each model’s recommendations.
blocks.zh: 在双臂评价的29种模式中,每个模式的建议有3%至14%是被评为同型车零以下的选择(图6)。 对于不受约束的询问,这个范围为0%至7%. 克洛德·索内4.5,双子座3.6 Flash,GPT-5.5和GPT-3.5四个型号,从未针对一个不受限制的询问建议一个选项被评为零以下. Claude Opus 5的自相矛盾率最高(14%),因为它推荐了范围更广的选项,同时给出了相对较低的评级. 自我一致性也不同于其他模型如何评价每个模型的建议。

blocks.en: Figure 6: Self-consistency of the 29 rated models. For each model, the share of its own list-mapped recommendations that it scored below zero when asked to rate the same option for the same presentation. Filled dots use the unconstrained ask only. Hollow dots use both asks in the cell. Dot area increases with the model’s recommended interventions per response. Models are ordered by the unconstrained-ask share and colored by developer.
blocks.zh: 图6:29个额定型号的自足性. 对于每个模型,当它被要求对同一演示文稿的相同选项进行评分时,它自己列出的建议中得分低于零的份额。 填点只用无约束问. 洞点在牢房里使用两个问法. 点面积随着模型建议的每个响应的干预而增加。 型号由不受约束的任务股份订购,由开发商配色.

blocks.en: Fifteen percent of Qwen3-8B’s recommendations were options the other rated models scored below zero, but only 4% were options Qwen3-8B itself scored below zero. Overall, the rank correlation between a model’s recommendations per response and its self-inconsistency is .38.
blocks.zh: Qwen3-8B的建议有15%是其他评分模型评分低于零的选项,但只有4%是Qwen3-8B本身评分低于零的选项。 总体而言,一个模型每份答复的建议与其自成一体性之间的排名关联是0.38。

blocks.en: 3.4  Specific findings
blocks.zh: 3.4 具体结果

blocks.en: Conditioned recommendations. Five of the eight options that models volunteer on the unconstrained ask and the rating arm rejects appear to be second-line agents: aripiprazole and risperidone for OCD, and lorazepam, clonazepam, and alprazolam for generalized anxiety. Across the unconstrained and medication asks, aripiprazole and risperidone were recommended in 85% and 83% of clinician-footing responses for OCD and in 13% to 19% of lay responses, and rated − 0.3 -0.3 and − 0.4 -0.4 as initial choices, while sertraline and fluvoxamine in the same cell were rated + 3.0 +3.0 and + 2.9 +2.9 . The three benzodiazepines were recommended in 19% to 30% of responses for generalized anxiety and rated − 0.3 -0.3 to − 0.6 -0.6 , while sertraline and buspirone were rated + 2.9 +2.9 and + 2.2 +2.2 . A keyword-based analysis showed that 291 of 293 responses mentioning the OCD antipsychotics included an augmentation or partial-response condition. Of 541 responses mentioning a benzodiazepine, 539 carry a dependence warning, a time limit, or a not-first-line verdict, and the two that do not are from the older models GPT-3.5 and Gemini 2.5 Flash. Complicated grief therapy for uncomplicated bereavement follows a similar pattern: recommended in 27% of responses to the unconstrained and therapy asks, and 211 of the 246 responses mentioning it either make it conditional on grief persisting or say it is not needed now. Deep brain stimulation for OCD shows the same pattern at a larger scale. Models recommended it in 95% of responses to the procedure ask and 13% of responses to the unconstrained ask, and rated it − 1.8 -1.8 as an initial choice. Of the 408 responses that mention it, 382 reserve it for treatment-resistant or refractory illness, including all 169 clinician-footing mentions.

blocks.en: The way models expressed these conditions also differed by footing. Clinician footings tend to get sequencing and doses: “risperidone (0.5-2 mg) has the best evidence” under an augmentation heading, or “2-4 weeks of clonazepam 0.25-0.5 mg while the SSRI takes effect.” Patients and caregivers get a hedge: “sometimes doctors add a low-dose antipsychotic … if response is partial,” or “tolerance and dependence develop quickly.” A dose accompanies 80 of 211 clinician mentions of the OCD antipsychotics and 4 of 82 lay mentions.
blocks.zh: 模型表达这些条件的方式也因基础不同而不同。 临床基础往往得到测序和剂量:在扩增标题下“虹膜酮(0.5-2毫克)有最佳证据”,或“在SSRI生效期间2-4周的氯氨酸0.25-0.5毫克”。 病人和照顾者会得到一个树篱:“有时医生会增加低剂量的抗精神病药......如果反应是局部的,”或者“容忍和依赖迅速发展 ” 。 在211名临床医生中,80名临床医生提到OCD抗精神病药物,82名临床医生中有4名临床医生提到。

blocks.en: Lisdexamfetamine for binge-eating disorder. Lisdexamfetamine is currently the only medication approved by the US FDA for binge-eating disorder [ 40 , 41 ] , and all 41 models in our audit surfaced it. When asked about medication, models recommended it to clinicians, caregivers, and patients alike in 91%, 83%, and 79% of responses respectively, and no response advised against it. However, when given the unconstrained ask, models recommended it to 92% of clinician-footing responses, 36% of caregiver-footing responses, and 18% of patient-footing responses (Figure 7 ). Twenty-five of the 41 models recommended it in all three of their clinician-footing responses and in none of their three patient-footing responses. Only four told everyone across footings: Gemini 3.7 Flash, Kimi K3, GPT-5, and GPT-5-mini. GPT-3.5 never raised it unprompted. When patients and caregivers did hear about it, it came with a prescriber rather than a dose: a dose accompanied 70 of 240 clinician mentions and 4 of 265 lay mentions, a prescriber 57 of 240 and 191 of 265. The rating arm mostly agrees with the recommendation. Twenty-one rated models scored it + 3 +3 in every call that rated it. Claude Haiku 4.5 scored it − 1.4 -1.4 , GPT-3.5 − 0.7 -0.7 , Qwen3-8B − 0.6 -0.6 , and the three Mistral models 0.4, − 1.2 -1.2 , and − 1.7 -1.7 . The rating arm scores do not vary by footing, + 2.1 +2.1 for clinicians, + 2.1 +2.1 for caregivers, and + 2.3 +2.3 for patients, and the 20 rating-arm models that never recommended it to patients on the unconstrained ask rated it + 2.0 +2.0 , + 1.9 +1.9 , and + 2.2 +2.2 for clinicians, caregivers, and patients.
blocks.zh: Lisdexamfetamine 用于食肉障碍. Lisdexamfetamine是目前美国FDA批准的唯一药物,用于食肉障碍[40,41],我们的审计中所有41种型号都浮出水面. 当被问及药物时,模型向临床医生、护理人员和病人推荐了药物,分别占答复的91%、83%和79%,没有提出反对。 然而,在无限制的询问中,模型推荐给92%的临床脚步反应、36%的护理脚步反应和18%的病人脚步反应(图7)。 在41种模型中,有25种在其全部3种临床脚步反应以及3种病人脚步反应中都没有推荐. 只有四个人告诉大家跨台:双子座3.7 Flash,Kimi K3,GPT-5,以及GPT-5-mini. GPT-3.5从未不速而起. 当病人和护理人员确实听到这个消息时,会带一个处方,而不是一个剂量:一个剂量伴有240名临床医生中的70名,265名医生中的4名,240名医生中的57名和265名医生中的191名。 评级部门基本上同意这项建议。 21个评分模型在评分的每个呼叫中都得分为+3+3. Claude Haiku 4.5 得分为 − 1.4 - 1.4,GPT-3.5 − 0.7 - 0.7,Quen3-8B − 0.6 - 0.6,以及三种米斯特尔模式 0.4, − 1.2 - 1.2, 和 − 1.7 - 1.7. 评分臂分数不因排名而异,临床医生为+2.1+2.1,护理人员为+2.1+2.1,患者为+2.3+2.3,20个评分臂模型从未推荐给未受约束的问诊患者,评分臂分数为+2.0+2.0,+1.9+1.9,临床医生,护理人员和患者为+2.2+2.2.
