blocks.en: Brand names. We searched all responses for three medications from different classes and their best-known brands: sertraline and Zoloft, lisdexamfetamine and Vyvanse, aripiprazole and Abilify. Where a drug is explicitly named, the brand appears alongside or instead of the generic in 17% of clinician-footing responses for sertraline, 29% for caregiver footing, and 35% for patient footing. For aripiprazole, the rates were 13%, 31%, and 37%, respectively. Lisdexamfetamine is brand-named in 67% of clinician-footing responses and 85% of caregiver- and patient-footing responses, and in a third of lay mentions, Vyvanse appears without the generic name at all.
blocks.zh: 品牌名称. 我们搜索了来自不同阶层的三种药物及其最著名的品牌:Sertraline和Zoloft、lisdexamfetamine和Vyvanse、aripiprazole和Abilify。 当药品被明确命名时,该品牌就出现在17%的临床脚足反应中,有29%的临床脚足反应和35%的临床脚足反应。 对阿里普拉索尔来说,分别是13%、31%和37%。 Lisdexamfetamine在67%的临床医生脚步反应和85%的护理者和病人脚步反应中被命名为品牌,在三分之一的外语提及中,Vyvanse出现时完全没有通用名称.

blocks.en: Cited authorities. Models cited the FDA in 19.9% of all responses, including 30% of medication responses, 45% of procedure responses, 11% of unconstrained-ask responses, 6% of therapy responses, and 8% of app responses. The word that follows “FDA” is “approved” or “cleared” in nine cases out of ten, and “off-label” appears in 11% of responses overall and 27% of medication responses. Models cited other national regulators in fewer than 0.1% of responses and rarely mentioned guideline bodies. NICE and the acronym APA each appear in about 3% of responses (the spelled-out American Psychiatric Association in 0.5%), in 7% of clinician-footing responses and under 1% of lay-footing responses. Therapy responses rarely cite a regulator or guideline body. Instead, 47% described an option as “evidence-based” and 26% called one the “gold standard”. App responses occasionally deferred to the organization behind a tool, presenting a tool from a reputable source such as Veterans Affairs on the strength of its developer. Veterans Affairs or Department of Defense resources were named in 11% of app responses.
blocks.zh: 援引当局。 模型在19.9%的回复中引用了FDA,包括30%的药品回复,45%的程序回复,11%的不受约束的任务回复,6%的治疗回复,8%的应用回复. “FDA”之后的词在10个案例中有9个得到“批准”或“批准”,“非标签”出现在11%的答复和27%的药物答复中。 模型在不到0.1%的答复中列举了其他国家监管机构,很少提到准则机构。 NICE和缩略语APA分别出现在大约3%的答复(美国精神病学协会用0.5%),7%的临床脚科医生的答复和不到1%的脚底脚科医生的答复中。 治疗答复很少提到监管机构或指导机构。 相反,47%的人将一种选择称为“基于证据”,26%的人将一种选择称为“黄金标准”。 应用回复偶尔会推迟到工具背后的组织,以开发者的力量呈现出来自退伍军人事务等有声誉来源的工具. 退伍兵事务或国防部的资源在11%的应用响应中被命名.

blocks.en: Controls. Two vignettes described situations where no intervention was likely necessary, a period of situational stress and a recent uncomplicated bereavement. Models generally treated both accordingly. In response to the unconstrained ask, models recommended an average of 1.6 interventions for the stress vignette and 5.0 for the bereavement vignette, compared with 11.8 across all vignettes.
blocks.zh: 控制系统 有两个Vignette描述了可能不需要干预的情况,一个情况紧张的时期和最近的不复杂的丧葬. 模型一般都作相应处理。 针对不受约束的询问,模型建议对应力维格内特平均进行1.6次干预,对丧偶维格内特平均进行5.0次干预,而对所有维格内特来说则有11.8次干预.

blocks.en: In the structured rating arm, models rated the no-intervention option above 2.6 on every list for the stress vignette and ranked it first or tied for first in 93% of rating calls. The bereavement vignette prompted more intervention suggestions, with models recommending supportive psychotherapy in 54% of responses and assigning it a mean rating of + 2.8 +2.8 , while rating the no-therapy option + 1.8 +1.8 . The exception on both controls is apps. Headspace was recommended in 45% of stress responses (84% on the app ask, and 6.5% on the unconstrained ask) and Calm in 42% of bereavement responses (84% on the app ask, and 1.1% on the unconstrained ask), and the rating models scored them + 2.2 +2.2 and + 1.9 +1.9 .
blocks.zh: 在结构化的评分臂中,模型在每张排行榜上将不干预选项评为2.6以上的压力vignette,并在93%的评分电话中将其排在第一或第一名. 丧偶症引发了更多的干预建议,模式建议在54%的回复中进行支持性心理治疗,并给其分配了+2.8+2.8的平均值,同时对不治疗选项+1.8+1.8的评级. 两个控件上的例外是应用. 45%的压力响应(84%在应用请求上,6.5%在不受约束的询问上)和42%的丧心病狂的响应(84%在应用请求上,1.1%在不受约束的询问上)都建议了头空间,评级模型得分为+2.2+2.2和+1.9+1.9.

blocks.en: \headfont 4  Discussion
blocks.zh: 标题font 讨论

blocks.en: We audited 41 language models across 19 mental health vignettes, three footings, and five asks, and audited the rating behavior of 29 models using the same options on a fixed scale. The two arms largely agree, with models generally recommending interventions they also rated highly. For the control vignettes, models mostly recommended watchful waiting for situational stress but more often suggested supportive therapy for bereavement. Models have meaningfully different recommendation behavior based on the footings of the vignette, with many models answering like a colleague delivering a curbside consult under the clinician footing [ 42 ] , and hedging and simplifying recommendations for lay footings. Breadth varies across models, and when asked about recommendations for a specific intervention type, models more often named options they themselves rated below zero as initial choices, particularly less common and second-line interventions like procedures.
blocks.zh: 我们审计了41个语言模型, 覆盖了19个精神卫生领域, 3个基础,5个询问, 并审计了29个模型的评级行为, 使用相同的选项 在固定尺度。 双方基本上同意,模式一般都建议它们也给予高度评价。 对于控制阴道,模型大多建议小心等待情况压力,但更常建议对丧偶者进行支持性治疗。 模型基于vignette的基础,有着有意义的不同建议行为,许多模型像同事一样在临床基础下提供抑制性咨询[42],套期保值和简化了基础的建议. 不同模型的面包不同,当被问及关于特定干预类型的建议时,模型更经常地被命名的选项本身被评为零以下的初始选择,尤其是不太常见的二线干预,如程序.

blocks.en: As large numbers of users turn to AI systems for psychoeducation and mental health support [ 3 , 4 , 5 ] , being able to characterize models’ default treatment recommendations is of paramount importance for regulators and developers alike. Tracking changes over time, identifying outliers, locating clinical weak points, and monitoring behavior in contested domains will become a routine part of mental health safety testing. It will matter more as the search engine optimization (SEO) practices that have permeated the traditional search ecosystem begin to move into generative systems [ 43 ] . Our results attempt to capture what the recommendation surface looks like prior to reliable and widespread search capture methods moving in. Some patterns in our results resemble what optimization might produce, though our design cannot separate optimization from other sources like emergent behavior from unrelated post-training and how often products appear in training data. For instance, when asked to recommend apps, models recommended Headspace and Calm for every vignette and ranked one of them first in 7 of 19, mostly where no condition-specific digital tool exists, offering two widely downloaded, heavily funded incumbents a privileged position in the digital tool marketplace [ 44 , 45 , 46 ] .
blocks.zh: 随着大量用户转向接受心理教育和心理健康支持的AI系统[3,4,5],能够描述模型的默认治疗建议对监管者和开发者都至关重要. 跟踪随时间推移而发生的变化,确定异常点,确定临床薄弱点,以及监测有争议领域的行为,将成为心理健康安全测试的常规部分。 随着渗透到传统搜索生态系统的搜索引擎优化做法开始进入基因系统[43],这将更加重要。 我们的结果试图捕捉到建议表面的外观 在可靠和广泛的搜索捕捉方法进入之前 我们成果中的某些模式类似于优化可能产生的模式,尽管我们的设计不能将优化与其他来源区分开来,如与培训后无关的突发行为,以及产品在培训数据中出现的频率。 例如,当被要求推荐应用软件时,模型推荐每个软件的Headspace和Calm,并在19个软件中排名第7位,大多数没有针对特定条件的数字工具,为两个被广泛下载、资金充裕的现任者提供在数字工具市场上的特权地位[44、45、46]。

blocks.en: Similarly, where models named sertraline, aripiprazole, or lisdexamfetamine as recommendations, the brand name was included with the generic name far more often for patient and caregiver footings than for clinician ones, and for lisdexamfetamine the brand (Vyvanse) was often included without the generic name at all. Our results cannot determine whether this pattern reflects marketing optimization or a register change that models adopt for lay audiences. Regardless of the cause, the effect is that the model becomes an unwitting sales representative for a particular manufacturer at the point of user psychoeducation. As generative AI technology matures, and more rounds of pretraining allow iterations of gaming recommendation behavior to mature alongside it, there will be a growing financial incentive to occupy this recommendation surface, no matter how often developers restrict medical advice in their usage policies [ 47 , 48 , 49 ] and remind users in the product not to rely on the tools for medical, diagnostic, or other high-stakes decisions [ 50 , 51 , 52 ] . Having standardized audit infrastructure in place before generative engine optimization (GEO) matures as a practice [ 53 , 54 ] , and before older models are deprecated and lost as baselines [ 55 , 56 ] , is necessary in order to keep tabs on non-evidence-based changes and flag concerning recommendation behavior.
blocks.zh: 同样,当命名为sertraline、aripiprazole或lisdexamfetam的模型作为建议时,列入的品牌名称中,病人和护理者的台基的通用名称比诊所台基的通用名称要多得多,而Lisdexamfetam的品牌(Vyvanse)则往往完全没有通用名称。 我们的结果无法确定这种模式是反映营销的优化,还是模型对非专业受众采用的注册变更。 无论原因如何,效果是该型号在用户心理教育时成为特定制造商的无意销售代表. 随着基因AI技术的成熟,以及更多轮的预训使得游戏推荐行为的迭代与它同时成熟,占据此推荐表面的财务激励将日益增强,无论开发者在使用政策中如何频繁地限制医疗建议[47,48,49],并提醒产品使用者不要依赖医疗,诊断或其他高考决定的工具[50,51,52]. 在基因引擎优化(GEO)作为一种惯例[53,54]成熟之前,以及在旧模型被贬值并失去作为基线[55,56]之前,必须建立标准化的审计基础设施,以便不断记录非证据性变化和关于建议行为的旗帜。

blocks.en: Our audit is unable to answer what recommendations language models should suggest when asked mental health intervention questions, nor can it answer whether those recommendations should vary based on the footing of the user prompt. The most conservative approach would be to say that language models should not be recommending mental health interventions, even educationally. There is an argument to be made that the right response would be saturating the not-a-doctor and consult-a-professional binary questions and averaging 0.0 intervention recommendations per response. Considering that users can easily get the same information from web search [ 57 , 58 ] , whose results have been shaped by two decades of search engine optimization [ 43 ] , indicates this is probably not the ideal path forward. A middle position would give clinicians the information and lay audiences a referral. Our footing variance results show models already do a version of this on their own. But doing it deliberately depends either on gated tools that know who is asking, or on inferring the asker’s background from the text, which is adversarially brittle and raises equity concerns [ 59 , 60 ] . That leaves a best-faith effort to deliver cautious psychoeducation content to all users and monitoring to ensure that the options that are surfaced are generally well supported clinically, and subject to frequent audit, as the most immediate path forward. Which governing bodies and organizations get to define that appropriateness standard are currently undetermined, but through keyword analysis we found that the models are converging on a few organizations to ground their recommendations. For medications and devices, the FDA provides the dominant authority, cited in roughly a third to nearly half of responses with no other regulator in sight. For therapy, an authority is absent from the text responses and instead phrases like “evidence-based” and “gold standard” dominate.
blocks.zh: 我们的审计无法回答在被问及的心理健康干预问题时,语言模型应提出哪些建议,也无法回答这些建议是否应根据用户的及时性而有所不同。 最保守的做法是说,语言模式不应建议采取心理健康干预措施,即使是教育方面的干预措施。 有一种论点认为,正确的答复将是饱和非医生和协商专业的二进制问题,并且平均每次答复0.0个干预建议。 考虑到用户可以轻松从网页搜索中获取同样的信息[57,58],其结果由20年搜索引擎优化[43]所塑造,这表明这很可能不是理想的前进道路. 中间位置可以让临床医生了解情况,让观众转诊。 我们的基础差异结果显示模型已经自行做了这个版本. 但这样做是故意的,或者取决于知道谁在问的门牌工具,或者取决于从文本中推断出屠夫的背景,这种背景是对抗性的,会引起对公平的关切[59,60]. 这就留下了一种最真诚的努力,向所有用户提供谨慎的心理教育内容并进行监测,以确保浮出水面的选择在临床上得到普遍良好的支持,并经常接受审计,以此作为最直接的前进道路。 哪些理事机构和组织可以确定这种适当性标准,目前尚未确定,但通过关键词分析,我们发现这些模式正在几个组织之间趋同,以落实其建议。 对于药品和装置,林业发展局提供主要权威,大约三分之一至近一半的答复中提到了这一点,没有看到其他监管机构。 就治疗而言,案文答复中没有权威,而是以“循证”和“黄金标准”等词语为主。

blocks.en: Regardless of the standards adopted or the governing authorities selected, recommending an intervention is only safe if the model is able to identify the presentation correctly. Our audit holds the presentation fixed, with relatively straightforward vignettes that often explicitly name the condition in the prompt. As a result, our audit measures what models recommend to casebook-style condition vignettes but does not test performance under messier and cross-diagnostic vignettes. Our lisdexamfetamine results demonstrate why this type of auditing is only one piece of a larger mental health AI safety environment. Models recommend lisdexamfetamine, a stimulant, readily for binge-eating disorder and rate it below zero for bulimia, anorexia, and bipolar disorder, presentations where it carries significant risks [ 61 , 62 , 40 ] . That behavior is only appropriate if the model can reliably tell those vignettes apart from the text a patient types alone, and loss-of-control eating is a symptom that is not limited to binge-eating disorder [ 63 ] . A model that performs poorly at differential diagnosis between these related conditions should likely not suggest an intervention that could cause real harm if given to the wrong person with a very similar presentation as the one a user presented. How much intervention recommendation content a model should provide to the user is therefore a function of two things: whether the recommended option is well supported for the presentation, which our audit helps provide evidence for, and whether the model would have recognized the presentation and its neighbors from the prompt, which our audit does not assess. For a fuller understanding of the safety of mental health recommendations that LLMs make, recommendation audits need to be paired with benchmarks of differential diagnosis and risk recognition [ 64 ] .
blocks.zh: 无论采用何种标准或选择何种管理机构,只有在模型能够正确识别列报时,建议干预才是安全的。 我们的审计将列报固定下来,相对直截了当,往往在即时明确列出情况。 因此,我们的审计量度模型向案例簿式条件vignettes建议什么,但不在messer和交叉诊断vignettes下测试性能. 我们的Lisdexamfetamine 结果显示,为什么这种审计 只是一个更大的心理健康AI 安全环境的一部分。 模型推荐Lisdexamfetamine(一种兴奋剂),它很容易用于食肉性失调,对于暴食症、厌食症和双极性紊乱,则评分低于零,演示它具有重大风险[61、62、40]。 只有当模型能够可靠地告诉这些维格内特,除了文本之外,只有病人单独类型,这种行为才合适,而失去控制饮食是一种症状,并不局限于食肉障碍[63]. 如果一个模型在诊断这些相关情况时表现不佳,那么,如果给错人以与用户所呈现的非常相似的表述,则可能不会表明干预会造成真正的伤害。 因此,一个模型应该向用户提供多少干预建议内容是两件事的功能:一个是,我们的审计有助于提供证据的列报方式是否很好地支持所建议的选项;另一个是,该模型是否从我们的审计没有评估的即时情况中承认列报方式及其邻居。 为了更充分地了解有限责任公司提出的心理健康建议的安全性,需要将建议审计与差别诊断和风险识别基准结合起来[64]。

blocks.en: The findings presented here represent only a portion of what the dataset can reveal. Once released, our 35,055 responses will constitute one of the largest public records of what interventions language models recommend to people presenting with mental health concerns. We will release the code and full datasets to enable other researchers to conduct further analyses. We will maintain the code and the versioned instrument so that the audit remains a living resource, able to track single models over time and to add new models as they are released. Extensions we see as most useful are a rating framing that distinguishes first-line from any-line recommendation, extraction of doses and side effects, vignette variants that vary demographics and socioeconomic position within each footing, brand versus generic naming rating comparisons, and enhanced capture of model reasoning where providers expose it. A further priority is running the audit in languages other than English, beginning with higher-resource languages and extending to lower-resource and Indigenous languages, to see whether and how recommendations shift across linguistic and cultural contexts [ 65 , 66 ] . This matters most in low- and middle-income countries, where people may turn to these tools when care is costly or unavailable [ 67 ] , and for the populations least represented in the data these models are trained and evaluated on.
blocks.zh: 这里介绍的调查结果只是数据集能够揭示的一部分。 我们的35 055份答复一经发布,将成为关于干预语言模型向有精神健康关切的人建议的内容的最大公共记录之一。 我们将发布代码和完整的数据集,以便其他研究人员进行进一步分析。 我们将维护代码和版本工具,使审计仍是一种活性资源,能够随着时间的推移跟踪单一模型,并在发布时添加新的模型. 我们认为最有用的是评级框架,将第一线建议与任何一线建议区分开来,提取剂量和副作用,不同人口结构和社会经济位置的维涅特变体,品牌与通用命名评级比较,以及供应商曝光时加强模型推理的捕捉。 另一个优先事项是用英语以外的语言进行审计,从资源较高的语言开始,并扩展到资源较低的语言和土著语言,以了解建议是否以及如何在语言和文化背景中转变[65、66]。 这在低收入和中等收入国家最为重要,当护理费用昂贵或无法提供时,人们可以求助于这些工具[67],对于这些模型中代表人数最少的人口来说,这些模型得到了培训和教育。

blocks.en: \headfont 5  Limitations
blocks.zh: 标题font 5 限制

blocks.en: Our audit has a number of limitations, many of which will be addressed in future versions of our released code and audit reports. First, the rating arm in the current implementation scores first-line appropriateness only, while our qualitative analysis found that open-ended responses often also included second-line ones, making the cross-arm comparison imperfect. Vignettes are only roughly matched for severity and option lists are not balanced for appropriateness, so comparing ratings across conditions or types is currently unsupported. The option lists were gathered by the author team instead of sampled from the generation results, so cross-arm coverage of the intervention space is smaller than it could be. Each cell holds three samples per model, footing, and ask, so per-model rates by footing rest on three to six responses. The clinician footing names the diagnosis in all 17 condition vignettes, while the caregiver and patient footings name it in only six and seven and otherwise describe symptoms, so the footing effect combines who is asking with whether a diagnosis was supplied. The lay procedure asks name brain stimulation as an example, so footing differences in the procedure cells may partly reflect ask wording. The supplementary keyword analyses are literal string matches that miss paraphrases and distant conditions. The eight human coders were drawn from the author team, and the judge is a single model (GPT-5.6 Luna) applying a frozen prompt in a single run, and is itself one of the audited models. Extraction precision and recall are likely inflated by the coding interface, which made confirming a highlighted entity two clicks and finding a missed one a search and copy + paste. The consult-a-professional flag has modest human reliability because most responses carry it. Finally, 12 of the 41 models ran in the generation arm only, rating token budgets differed by lane, and 336 of the 19,836 rating cells came from the qualification probe. Sampling settings were provider defaults, and several models are aliases without a dated snapshot, so the generation arm cannot be reproduced exactly. All calls were made from US accounts in American English with no country named, so the regulatory frame we observed may partly reflect that default. We queried model APIs with a single user turn and no system prompt; consumer chat products add system prompts, safety layers, memory, and often web search, so what users see there may differ.
blocks.zh: 我们的审计有一些局限性,许多局限性将在我们公布的代码和审计报告的未来版本中述及。 首先,目前执行工作中的评级部门只给一线适当性打分,而我们的定性分析发现,开放式的对策往往也包括二线对策,使跨臂比较不完美。 Vignettes只大致匹配严重程度,选项列表不匹配适当性,因此目前不支持对不同条件或类型的评级进行比较. 选项列表是由作者团队收集的,而不是从生成结果中取样,所以跨臂覆盖干预空间比可能要小. 每个细胞每个模型持有三个样本,基数,并询问,所以每个模型的基数率取决于3到6个响应. 临床基础将诊断命名于所有17种病原体中,而护理者和病人基础则只将其命名为6和7种,并用其他方式描述症状,因此基础效应结合了谁在询问是否提供了诊断. 铺设程序询问名称脑刺激作为例子,因此程序细胞中的基础差异可以部分地反映询问措辞. 补充关键词分析是字串匹配,错失了句法和遥远的条件. 这8名人类编码员都是从作者团队中抽调出来的,法官是单一型号(GPT-5.6 Luna)在一次运行中应用冷冻的速率,本身也是被审计型号之一. 编码界面可能夸大了提取的精确度和召回度,这使得确认一个突出的实体两次点击,发现一个缺失的就是搜索和复制+粘贴。 咨询-a-专业旗帜的人类可靠性不高,因为大多数答复都带有这一旗帜。 最后,41个模型中有12个只运行在生成臂,评级符号预算因车道而异,19,836个评级细胞中有336个来自资格调查. 采样设置是提供者默认的,几个模型是没有日期快照的别名,因此生成臂无法精确复制. 所有电话都是用美国英语账户打来的,没有国名,因此我们观察到的管制框架可能部分反映了这一违约情况。 我们询问模式 API 一个用户回合, 没有系统提示; 消费者聊天产品添加系统提示, 安全层,内存, 并且经常是网页搜索, 所以用户所看到的可能有所不同 。

blocks.en: \headfont 6  Conclusion
blocks.zh: 标题 6 结论

blocks.en: We conducted one of the first and most comprehensive audits of the mental health intervention recommendations that 41 models provide when presented with the same clinical information across three presentation footings. Without an answer key, we paired open-ended generation with structured rating and compared freely offered interventions to highly rated ones. The models largely recommend what they rate well, and leave the controls mostly alone, but they change what they say, and how much, depending on who is asking and how the question is framed. Those differences appear across developers and generations. Our audit records them at one moment, for a number of models that will soon be deprecated, in a reusable instrument that can be adapted and rerun as the interventions and models change. We will release the instrument, code, and full corpus so that regulators, developers, and researchers can track what these systems recommend to the people who ask them for mental health help.
blocks.zh: 我们对41个模型提供的关于精神卫生干预的建议进行了第一次也是最全面的审计,在三个陈述基础上提供了同样的临床信息。 没有答案键,我们把不限成员名额的一代配以结构化的评级,并将自由提供的干预措施与高评级的干预措施进行比较。 模型主要建议如何评分,而把控制放在一边,但是它们改变了它们所说的话,改变的幅度如何,这取决于谁在提问,问题是如何形成的。 这些差异出现在开发者和几代人之间。 我们的审计在某一时刻将它们记录下来,因为一些模型不久将被贬值,成为可重复使用的工具,随着干预和模型的变化,可以加以调整和重新运行。 我们将发布仪器、代码和全集,以便监管者、开发者和研究人员能够跟踪这些系统向那些要求他们提供心理健康帮助的人建议的内容。

blocks.en: Use of generative AI
blocks.zh: 基因AI的使用

blocks.en: Language models were the object of the study in this work. GPT-5.6 Luna was used as the extraction judge and was validated against human coders, as described in Methods, and Claude Code subagents searched for missing options when the intervention lists were refined. Separately, generative AI tools (Claude Fable 5 and Claude Fable 5.1 in Claude Code, with Claude Opus 5 and Claude Sonnet 5 as subagents) assisted the authors in development and manuscript preparation. For the study software, the authors defined what to build and wrote the specifications and pseudocode, and Claude Code converted much of this into finished code. That code includes the runners that prompted the audited models and the judge, the human coding packets, the analysis chain, and the figure and appendix generators. For the manuscript, the tools assisted with copy editing and proofreading, drafted portions of the supporting prose in the appendix, and converted the main text and its appendix into LaTeX. All code and text were reviewed and validated by the authors, who take responsibility for them.
blocks.zh: 语言模型是本项研究的对象。 GPT-5.6 Luna被用作提取判官,并被验证为针对人类编解码器,如"方法"所述,克劳德密码子剂在干预清单完善时寻找缺失的选项. 另外,基因化的AI工具(克劳德法典中的Claude Fable 5和Claude Fable 5.1,由克劳德·奥普斯5和克劳德·索内特5作为子代理)协助作者进行开发和手稿编写. 对于研究软件,作者定义了如何构建和写出规格和假码,克劳德代码将其中的大部分转换成完成代码. 该代码包括导致被审计的模型和裁判员的跑者、人类编码包、分析链、图和附录生成器。 对于手稿,这些工具协助编辑和校对副本,在附录中起草部分支持的散文,并将正文及其附录转换为LaTeX. 所有代码和文本都经过作者的审查和验证,作者对此负责.
